top_signals.title: Unilever India Shares Slide Most Since 2020 on Growth Woes
top_signals.summary: Hindustan Unilever Ltd.’s shares recorded their biggest single-day fall in over six years on concerns around slowing growth and persistent raw material inflation even as its quarterly profit beat analyst expectations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
